items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.

items.title: GE Aerospace Faces Cost Inflation: A Threat to Margin Growth?
items.summary: GE is expanding manufacturing and MRO capacity to capture rising demand, but escalating costs are putting pressure on margins and profitability.

items.title: Can DeepStrike JR3 Strengthen RTX's Precision Fires Growth?

items.title: Rocket Lab Stock Could Be Headed for a Breakout. Here’s My 2027 Price Prediction
items.summary: Rocket Lab keeps landing bigger missions, yet its shares sit far below their peak. A delayed rocket, a hefty valuation premium, and a defense windfall could decide whether 2027 delivers the comeback or another letdown.

items.title: Is RTX (RTX) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: According to the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), one should invest in RTX (RTX). It is debatable whether this highly sought-after metric is effective because Wall Street analysts' recommendations tend to be overly optimistic. Would it be worth investing in the stock?
